invariants.rationale: Parallelism likely expected to be positive for parallel operations.
If input data is not null, its size is non-negative by definition.
A non-null mapper function is required for mapToPair, or the process will fail.
A non-null reducer function is required for reduceByKey, or the reduction step will fail.
Parallelism should not exceed the number of data elements, or some workers may be idle.
